vectors.description: draft-mzanaty-moq-loc-05 2.3 declares an even type's value as Length bytes, but its [MoQTransport], draft-ietf-moq-transport-10 9.1.1.2, frames an even type's value as one varint. Video Config (2.3.2.1) declares codec extradata of varying length; the varint 1 cannot be that, so the value is left uninterpreted.
